name: Entrepreneurship
description: Opportunity identification, customer problem validation, unit economics, and execution velocity.

dimensions.name: Problem Validation
dimensions.description: Distinguishing urgent, hair-on-fire problems from nice-to-haves; identifying willingness to pay.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Pinpoints exact workflow friction, quantifiable customer loss, proven willingness to pay.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Identifies real problem but evidence of willingness to pay is theoretical.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Solution in search of a problem; vague buyer persona.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Hallucinated problem; no economic pain point identified.

dimensions.name: Unit Economics & Viability
dimensions.description: CAC, LTV, gross margins, payback period, churn estimation, and operational levers.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Realistic CAC/LTV calculus, margin protection, clear path to cash-flow positive.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Solid unit math with minor unaddressed operational costs.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Unrealistic CAC assumptions or flawed margin calculations.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Ignores cost of goods, distribution friction, or math violates basic business physics.

dimensions.name: Execution Velocity & MVP
dimensions.description: Ability to de-risk assumptions in 48 hours with minimal software and brutal prioritization.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Cuts scope ruthlessly; designs a rapid, zero-bloat smoke test or prototype in days.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Good MVP plan with slight tendency toward premature feature building.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Over-engineers early version; takes months to test simple assumption.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Paralysis by analysis; plans full product before any customer validation.

dimensions.name: Distribution & GTM Strategy
dimensions.description: Non-obvious acquisition channels, cold outbound loops, programmatic SEO, virality mechanics.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Specific, scalable distribution moat identified with low CAC entry point.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Viable standard marketing channels with clear execution steps.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Relies on generic 'social media' or 'word of mouth' without mechanics.
rubricCriteria.0-49: 'Build it and they will come' fantasy; no distribution hypothesis.
